text: Kakhovka dam. You can see the streets and houses just beyond it. Your job is to intercept the aircraft over this area. Keep your fire clear of the dam itself.
Understood. My father always left the kitchen light on until I got home. I’d like to see lights in those windows down there tonight.
Our forces are clearing the airspace in an orderly fashion. You’ll agree that the farther they get from the dragon, the more space they’ve cleared. We showed you a map yesterday. That should suffice.
Let them talk. I’ve got the number of a local electrician. When you land, I’ll give him a ring and ask if the lights are on.
Understood. When we get back, let’s make that call together.
